name: How long does a site feasibility consultation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a site feasibility consultation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical site feasibility consultation involves an initial site visit and subsequent research and report preparation. The on-site portion usually lasts 1-2 hours, allowing for a thorough visual inspection and discussion. The full process, including research into local regulations and a detailed report, can take several days to a week to complete, depending on the complexity of the site and local permitting requirements.
